{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Model tends to overestimate prices in the short term (1-3 days) after recent spikes, especially when sentiment is neutral or slightly positive.",
    "Underestimates prices during sustained upward trends, particularly when sentiment remains flat or shows minimal positive bias.",
    "Overcorrects downward after sharp price increases, leading to premature troughs — adjust by adding 5-10% buffer to forecasted lows.",
    "Mean reversion is overemphasized — reduce forecast volatility in the 10-30 day horizon when sentiment is stable.",
    "When sentiment is positive (≥0.25), model should increase forecast by 2-5% to account for bullish momentum.",
    "When sentiment is negative (≤-0.25), model should reduce forecast by 3-7% to reflect bearish pressure.",
    "Avoid forecasting sharp upward moves in the 30-day horizon unless sentiment is strongly positive and recent price action shows breakout momentum."
  ]
}
